data_fields.name: move_max_calls
data_fields.donor_constant: argument per call (maxMoveTime, nil = no cap); snaps to target when passed

data_fields.name: watch_persistent_type
data_fields.donor_constant: evType 1 persistent, any other value one-shot

best_idea: One sequencer for scripted beats: each step returns done or retry, a shared wait gate counts down once per tick, the input is locked while a beat plays, and a skip runs the beat's final state once.
decision_why: Keep the step-until-done loop, the shared wait gate, the input lock and the skip; drop the direct gear writes (position, velocity, message bits) so a beat moves only the presentation rig, and use stable watch ids (the donor's index bookkeeping can skip or remove the wrong entry, hand-traced).
acceptance: In the Pit a finisher beat runs its steps in order; skip ends it in one frame in its final pose; move and attack inputs are ignored on the client during the beat while the server fight clock keeps running; a test removes an earlier watch during a pass and asserts no other watch is skipped or removed.
